content.text: House of the Dragon is set 172 years before the events of Game of Thrones and chronicles the reign of House Targaryen at the height of its power. When King Viserys I breaks with tradition to name his daughter Rhaenyra his heir, the decision ignites a succession crisis that splits the family — and the realm — into two warring factions. Based on George R.R. Martin's Fire & Blood, the series traces the road to civil war known as the Dance of the Dragons.

At Lumon Industries, a select group of employees undergo "severance" — an experimental procedure that surgically splits memory in two, so the person who clocks in each morning has no idea who they are outside the elevator, and the person who goes home has no memory of what happens at work. Mark S. leads the severed floor's Macrodata Refinement team through endless days spent sorting mysterious numbers, insulated from grief, love, and the outside world — until a newly hired teammate starts asking the one question Lumon never wanted asked: what are we actually doing down here?
